returns all transactions that need to be submitted to do a settings upgrade

usage:
  stellar-core get-settings-upgrade-txs <PublicKey> <SequenceNumber> <NetworkPassphrase> options

where options are:
  -?, -h, --help                           display usage information
  --xdr <XDR-BASE64>                       ConfigUpgradeSet in base64
  --signtxs                                sign all transactions
  --add-resource-fee <ADD-RESOURCE-FEE>    additional resource fee for all
                                           the transactions
